# Laboratory 3D Assets Attributions

All 3D laboratory equipment models in Assets/Models/ (Bunsen Burner, Crucible Tongs, Watch Glass,
Laboratory Table, Sandpaper, Magnesium Ribbon, MgO Residue, MgO Powder) were procedurally
generated and custom modeled for this virtual chemistry laboratory.

- Bunsen Burner:       Custom procedural PBR low-poly model — brass/olive-gold aged metal finish
- Crucible Tongs:      Custom scissor-pivot dark-charcoal steel laboratory tongs model
- Watch Glass:         Custom curved transparent laboratory dish model — high-transparency glass
- Sandpaper:           Custom textured warm-brown abrasive pad model
- Magnesium Ribbon:    Custom thin silver metallic ribbon model with enlarged interaction collider
- MgO Powder:          Custom white powdery ash reaction product model
- MgO Residue:         Custom white solid ash reaction product model

Visual Overhaul (August 2026):
- Extended burning duration (6 s), heating (2.5 s), cleaning (0.45 acc divisor)
- Added white smoke/particulate particle system during combustion
- Dark charcoal tongs material matching reference images
- Cleaning progress bar, equipment tooltip labels
- Burning status info panel with Bunsen ON/OFF status, ribbon state, observation
- Persistent equation panel: 2Mg + O2 -> 2MgO
- Previous/Next navigation buttons
- MgO correctly labeled as white solid ash / particulate (not a gas)
- EquipmentLabelPositioner MonoBehaviour for world-to-screen label projection
